prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic overall, though several winning tests (such as sign_in redesign in round 6, choose_path redesign in round 10, adoption incentive in round 13, adoption new_flow in round 12, and choose_path copy in round 14) were underpredicted.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 2 of 7 tests, while the remaining 5 tests showed no clear effect.
Home wait_info changes were helpful, winning 2 of 7 tests (rounds 13 and 14), while the other 5 tests showed no clear effect.
Finish redesign changes (6 tests) and finish new_screen changes (3 tests) consistently showed no clear effect or hurt performance, with zero wins.
Adoption redesign changes (5 tests) and adoption layout changes (3 tests) consistently showed no clear effect or hurt performance, with zero wins.
Evidence remains thin or outcomes are mixed for single-test categories and categories with conflicting results (such as home notification, adoption new_flow, adoption incentive, choose_path layout, choose_path redesign, choose_path copy, and sign_in redesign).

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Welcome Card Layout Redesign: Redesign the initial onboarding story screen into a clean card layout highlighting your pet journey. (why: The choose_path step has a high mean duration (514s), indicating users linger or experience friction before selecting a path.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Compact Choice Layout Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend selection view using a compact layout for faster comparison of preset pet options. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 66.9% with an 89s median completion time, suggesting choice friction during pet selection.)
2: [finish, redesign] Desk Setup Checklist Welcome Redesign: Rebuild the final home_intro screen into a structured checklist layout detailing how controls and visibility work. (why: The finish step drops to 68.0% conversion, and support emails cite confusion about pet controls and visibility post-onboarding.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Step Engine Ready Wait Info: Add an explicit progress bar and dynamic wait information components to the waiting screen while desktop assets load. (why: The home wait step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, creating drop-off without continuous status updates.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Multi Account Recovery Safeguard Hint: Display a prominent hint on the sign-in screen reminding users to sign into their primary account to preserve existing pets. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in with a different or secondary account.)
5: [adoption, hint] Pet Creation Quality Upload Hint: Add clear guidance hints on the photo upload screen to help users provide high quality images for custom pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Control Overview Setup Notification: Enable desktop readiness notifications on the final setup screen so users are notified as soon as the pet spawns. (why: 3 support messages noted pets not showing immediately on desktop or confusion about when setup completes.)
7: [choose_path, new_flow] Choose Path Companion Journey Redesign: Transform the path selection screen with side-by-side interactive choice cards for preset companion adoption vs custom pet creation. (why: Choose path is the first decision point; structured option cards help users commit faster than a simple list.)
8: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Secure Account Layout Redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a focused spotlight layout that highlights single-click social sign-in options. (why: Sign-in drop-off is 84.7% with high mean duration (567s) and reports of sign-in screen stalling.)
